#### pub fn [new](https://docs.rs#method.new)(
    requested_locale: &'a [str](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.str.html),
    source_locale: &'a [str](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.str.html),
) -> [CompileCatalogArtifactOptions](https://docs.rs/struct.CompileCatalogArtifactOptions.html)<'a>

Creates artifact compile options with required locales set.

Optional fields default to an empty fallback chain, `FerrocatV1` keys,
no source fallback, non-strict ICU diagnostics, no ICU compatibility
check, and ICU-native semantics.

```
16fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
17    let source = catalog(
18        "msgid \"Checkout\"\nmsgstr \"Checkout\"\n\nmsgid \"Cart\"\nmsgstr \"Cart\"\n",
19        "en",
20    )?;
21    let german = catalog("msgid \"Checkout\"\nmsgstr \"Zur Kasse\"\n", "de")?;
22
23    let options = CompileCatalogArtifactOptions::new("de", "en").with_source_fallback(true);
24    let artifact = compile_catalog_artifact(&[&source, &german], &options)?;
25
26    assert_eq!(artifact.messages.len(), 2);
27    assert_eq!(artifact.missing.len(), 1);
28    assert!(artifact.messages.values().any(|value| value == "Zur Kasse"));
29    assert!(artifact.messages.values().any(|value| value == "Cart"));
30
31    for (key, value) in &artifact.messages {
32        println!("{key} = {value}");
33    }
34
35    Ok(())
36}
```

`catalog`## Expand description

Host-neutral compiled runtime artifact for one requested locale.

When the `serde` feature is enabled, this type serializes with
[ COMPILED_CATALOG_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_VERSION](https://docs.rs/catalog/constant.COMPILED_CATALOG_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_VERSION.html) as a required

`schema_version` field. Deserialization rejects unknown artifact schema
versions.## Fields[§](https://docs.rs#fields)

# compile_catalog_artifact_report in ferrocat - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/ferrocat/2.1.0/ferrocat/fn.compile_catalog_artifact_report.html

```
pub fn compile_catalog_artifact_report(
    catalogs: &[&
```
[NormalizedParsedCatalog](https://docs.rs/struct.NormalizedParsedCatalog.html)],
    options: &[CompileCatalogArtifactReportOptions](https://docs.rs/struct.CompileCatalogArtifactReportOptions.html)<'_>,
) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[CompiledCatalogArtifactReport](https://docs.rs/struct.CompiledCatalogArtifactReport.html), [ApiError](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html)>**crate feature**only.

`catalog`## Expand description

Compiles one requested-locale runtime artifact with a sibling provenance report.

This is the report-oriented entry point for both full and selected artifact
compilation. The returned artifact uses the same schema and semantics as
[ compile_catalog_artifact](https://docs.rs/fn.compile_catalog_artifact.html), while the sibling provenance report records how
each compiled source identity resolved.

[§](https://docs.rs#errors)Errors

Returns [ ApiError::InvalidArguments](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.InvalidArguments) when required locales are missing,
duplicated, or inconsistent with the provided catalog set; when selected IDs
are unknown or absent from the catalog set;

[when two source identities compile to the same derived key; or](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.Conflict)

`ApiError::Conflict`[when](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.Unsupported)

`ApiError::Unsupported``strict_icu` is enabled and a final runtime message fails ICU validation.

# compile_catalog_artifact in ferrocat - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/ferrocat/2.1.0/ferrocat/fn.compile_catalog_artifact.html

```
pub fn compile_catalog_artifact(
    catalogs: &[&
```
[NormalizedParsedCatalog](https://docs.rs/struct.NormalizedParsedCatalog.html)],
    options: &[CompileCatalogArtifactOptions](https://docs.rs/struct.CompileCatalogArtifactOptions.html)<'_>,
) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[CompiledCatalogArtifact](https://docs.rs/struct.CompiledCatalogArtifact.html), [ApiError](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html)>**crate feature**only.

`catalog`## Expand description

Compiles one requested-locale runtime artifact from one or more normalized catalogs.

The artifact is host-neutral: it produces the final runtime message strings keyed by Ferrocat’s derived lookup key, plus missing-message records and compile diagnostics.

[§](https://docs.rs#errors)Errors

Returns [ ApiError::InvalidArguments](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.InvalidArguments) when required locales are missing, duplicated,
or inconsistent with the provided catalog set;

[when two source identities compile to the same derived key; or](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.Conflict)

`ApiError::Conflict`[when](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.Unsupported)

`ApiError::Unsupported``strict_icu` is enabled and a final runtime message fails ICU validation.```
16fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
17    let source = catalog(
18        "msgid \"Checkout\"\nmsgstr \"Checkout\"\n\nmsgid \"Cart\"\nmsgstr \"Cart\"\n",
19        "en",
20    )?;
21    let german = catalog("msgid \"Checkout\"\nmsgstr \"Zur Kasse\"\n", "de")?;
22
23    let options = CompileCatalogArtifactOptions::new("de", "en").with_source_fallback(true);
24    let artifact = compile_catalog_artifact(&[&source, &german], &options)?;
25
26    assert_eq!(artifact.messages.len(), 2);
27    assert_eq!(artifact.missing.len(), 1);
28    assert!(artifact.messages.values().any(|value| value == "Zur Kasse"));
29    assert!(artifact.messages.values().any(|value| value == "Cart"));
30
31    for (key, value) in &artifact.messages {
32        println!("{key} = {value}");
33    }
34
35    Ok(())
36}
```

# CompiledCatalogIdIndex in ferrocat - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/ferrocat/2.1.0/ferrocat/struct.CompiledCatalogIdIndex.html

`pub struct CompiledCatalogIdIndex { /* private fields */ }`**crate feature**only.

`catalog`## Expand description

Stable compiled runtime ID index built from one or more normalized catalogs.

Describes selected compiled IDs against a provided catalog set.

[§](https://docs.rs#errors-1)Errors

Returns [ ApiError::InvalidArguments](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.InvalidArguments) when a provided catalog does not declare
a locale, or

[when the same compiled ID maps to different translation kinds across the provided catalogs.](https://docs.rs/enum.ApiError.html#variant.Conflict)
